evidence.section: 4.1 Plastic deformation mechanism from RT to 900K
evidence.quote: The excellent mechanical properties of Ni-based single crystal superalloys are primarily determined by their two-phase microstructure and the associated deformation mechanisms. The γ phase is an FCC solid solution, while the γ′ phase is an intermetallic compound with an L12 structure.
